questions.q: True or false? Blue must wait until our defender touches the ball.
questions.explain: Right, it's false. Once the kick moves the ball, blue can press.
choiceExplanations: Blue can come once the kick is taken and the ball moves.
Right, it's false. Once the kick moves the ball, blue can press.

questions.q: A goal kick with the build-out line. Put the steps in order.
options: Blue moves back past the line
Keeper kicks to the left defender
Blue may now cross the line
questions.explain: Right. Blue moves back, we kick, blue may come, so we pass on.
choiceExplanations: Right. Blue moves back, we kick, blue may come, so we pass on.
The keeper kicks only after blue has moved back past the line.
Blue may cross the line only after the kick moves the ball.
The defender passes to midfield last, before the pressure arrives.

questions.q: Before the kick, blue's forward is too close. Where must they go?
questions.explain: Yes. Blue moves past the line, so we have room to restart.
choiceExplanations: That is even closer to our keeper. Blue must give us room.
Standing on the line is not enough. Blue must move past it.
Yes. Blue moves past the line, so we have room to restart.
